cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James announced the launch of Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, risk-based model portfolios combining equity and fixed income with a dedicated alternatives sleeve for high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: the firm announced the launch of Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, a risk-based model framework that combines equity and fixed income allocations with a dedicated alternatives sleeve covering private markets and hedged strategies.
items.scope: Private Client Group / high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth advisors

items.text: Raymond James launched a firm-wide SIMPLE IRA Employer Advisory and Consulting Services Program (SIACS), partnered with Capital Group American Funds, for small businesses with up to 100 employees.
items.quote: The St. Petersburg, Fla.-based wealth manager has launched a firm-wide SIMPLE IRA Employer Advisory and Consulting Services Program, according to the filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The firm has partnered with Capital Group American Funds for the program

items.text: Raymond James will add $18.7 billion to its Financial Institutions Division as an existing FID program merges with Synovus Financial Corp. in connection with Pinnacle Financial Partners.
items.quote: Raymond James will add $18.7 billion and 70 advisors to its Financial Institutions Division, the unit dedicated to bank and credit union advisors, as an existing FID program merges with Synovus Financial Corp.

items.text: Raymond James said 70 advisors will be added to its Financial Institutions Division through the Synovus/Pinnacle program merger, expected to transition in May 2027.
items.quote: The advisors are expected to transition in May 2027.

items.text: Raymond James closed its acquisition of Clark Capital Management Group, a Philadelphia asset manager with more than $46 billion under management, in May 2026.
items.quote: the firm agreed to acquire Clark Capital Management Group, a Philadelphia-based asset manager with more than $46 billion under management ... That transaction closed in May 2026 and added Clark Capital as an independent boutique within Raymond James Investment Management's multi-boutique structure.

items.text: Raymond James has also launched a suite of proprietary active exchange-traded funds and is piloting an AI-powered advisor assistant called Raimond.
items.quote: The firm also launched a suite of proprietary active exchange-traded funds in October 2025 and is piloting an AI-powered advisor assistant called Raimond

items.text: Raymond James & Associates added a PNC Private Bank team in Washington, D.C. managing over $1.5 billion in client assets, operating as KKM Wealth Partners within Alex. Brown.
items.quote: Raymond James & Associates (RJA) - the firm's employee advisor channel - has welcomed Kenneth "Ken" Killfoil ... and Kris Morin ... The team, based in Washington, D.C., arrives from PNC Private Bank, where it managed over $1.5 billion in client assets.
items.scope: Raymond James & Associates employee advisor channel

items.text: Raymond James & Associates recruited a Richmond, Virginia duo from Truist Investment Services whose practice managed more than $1.2 billion in client assets.
items.quote: Two veteran Virginia wealth managers have moved their practice to Raymond James & Associates, adding more than $1.2 billion in client assets to the firm's employee advisor channel.
items.scope: Raymond James & Associates employee advisor channel

items.text: Raymond James & Associates added a four-person UBS Financial Services team in Beachwood, Ohio that managed more than $700 million in client assets.
items.quote: Raymond James & Associates (RJA), the firm's employee advisor channel, welcomed financial advisors Thomas Massey ... to its Beachwood, Ohio office. ... they collectively managed more than $700 million in client assets.
items.scope: Raymond James & Associates employee advisor channel

items.text: Raymond James Financial Services added a five-advisor team from Commonwealth Financial Network in Rochester, New York, approximately $500 million in client assets, operating as Harris Wealth Partners.
items.quote: Raymond James Financial Services (RJFS) welcomed a five-advisor team from Commonwealth Financial Network to its independent advisor channel , adding approximately $500 million in client assets to its roster.
items.scope: Raymond James Financial Services independent advisor channel

items.text: Independent advisor Jeffrey Stillwell affiliated with Raymond James Financial Services from Ameriprise, where he managed approximately $240 million in client assets.
items.quote: In New Jersey, independent financial advisor Jeffrey Stillwell, CLU, has affiliated with Raymond James Financial Services , the independent channel of Raymond James Financial. He managed approximately $240 million in client assets at his old firm, Ameriprise Financial Services.
items.scope: Raymond James Financial Services independent channel

items.text: Janney Montgomery Scott opened a Houston office with a team departing Raymond James that had amassed $3.3 billion in client assets under management.
items.quote: The Edward Fitzpatrick Group ... had been with Raymond James for about 23 years, during which it had amassed $3.3 billion in client assets under management
items.scope: departing Raymond James team (Edward Fitzpatrick Group)

items.text: Four advisory practices left Raymond James Financial Services for Ascentis Independent Advisors, bringing more than $1 billion in client assets, while continuing to use Raymond James as primary custodian.
items.quote: Ascentis Independent Advisors ... has added more than $1 billion in client assets through four advisory practices that joined from Raymond James Financial Services ... will continue to use Raymond James as their primary custodian
items.scope: departing Raymond James Financial Services practices

items.text: Raymond James no longer reports advisor headcount, having last officially broken it out at about 8,900 advisors.
items.quote: Raymond James no longer reports advisor headcount, but it had about 8,900 advisors the last time headcount was officially broken out.

items.text: On M&A, Chief Executive Paul Shoukry said Raymond James looks for acquisitions in wealth management but they must be a good cultural and strategic fit, done to grow revenues rather than slash costs.
items.quote: When asked about M&A, Shoukry said the firm does look for acquisitions in the wealth management business in particular, but it would have to be a good cultural and strategic fit. "We don't do acquisitions to slash costs," he said.
